about: What `fast-test` runs for a change (see ~/Code/fast-test). Quick steps run on The Dragon; Clippy and the Rust tests run on The Beast, where a wide change runs the full suite instead. Windows and macOS: GitHub's ci.yml, every night and before a release (AGENTS.md). The Docker image build stays with the Docker workflow.

steps.name: rust-clippy
steps.about: Clippy of the crate, in a build folder of its own under the kept Cargo target, on The Beast: it compiles the whole crate.

steps.name: rust
steps.about: The tests of the changed modules (src/quota/x.rs runs the tests named quota::x::…), on The Beast: building the test binary compiles the whole crate.
steps.run: set --; for f in {files}; do m=${f#src/}; m=${m%.rs}; m=${m%/mod}; set -- "$@" "$(printf %s "$m" | sed 's#/#::#g')::"; done; cargo test --locked -- "$@"

steps.name: python
steps.about: The scripts' Python tests, and the one that keeps the Rust version the same everywhere.

full: cargo fmt --check && { CARGO_TARGET_DIR="${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/clippy" cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings > /tmp/clippy.log 2>&1 & cargo test --locked --config "profile.dev.package.'*'.opt-level=2"; t=$?; wait $!; c=$?; cat /tmp/clippy.log; [ $t = 0 ] && [ $c = 0 ]; } && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && N=/cache/npm/node-v24.21.0-linux-x64 && { [ -x $N/bin/node ] || curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.21.0/node-v24.21.0-linux-x64.tar.xz | tar -xJ -C /cache/npm; } && $N/bin/node --test tests/*.test.cjs

nightly.about: Windows and macOS: the nightly run has GitHub run CI for the same commit.
